theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmb_fcd_fr_coordinate_covectors
theorems.statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ), ∃ dx : (Fin k → Fin P) → Covector (Euclid P) k, (∀ I J : Fin k → Fin P, StrictMono I → StrictMono J → dx J (fun r => EuclideanSpace.single (I r) (1 : ℝ)) = if I = J then 1 else 0) ∧ ∀ (N : ℕ) (J : Fin N → Fin k → Fin P) (c : Fin N → ℝ), Function.Injective J → (∀ l, StrictMono (J l)) → covectorEuclideanNorm (∑ l, c l • dx (J l)) = Real.sqrt (∑ l, c l ^ 2)
